name: HuaMeng TG 3x3 (MagLev + Ball-Core + UV)
description: The HuaMeng TG is the most feature-rich 3x3 we’ve seen so far! With 1620 different adjustment combinations you can find one that fits your turning style. It has hand-adjustable compression settings and a tool to adjust tensions and magnet strength. It has 6 tension settings, 9 compression settings, 5 edge magnet adjustments, and 6 corner/core magnet adjustments.
